bindings_patch_style_constraints: Treat auto-discovered unknown subsystems as manual-review-first plans until a dedicated family profile exists.
Prefer conservative translation output over subsystem-specific invention when the AutoProfiler cannot prove a richer abstraction surface.

driver_generation_rules: Treat this auto-discovered module as a planning target only; keep translation output conservative until a dedicated family profile exists.
Prefer manual-review placeholders over subsystem-specific helper invention when the callback semantics are not yet modeled.

driver_side_rules: Do not use `unsafe` in driver code, including `unsafe impl`, `unsafe fn`, or `unsafe {}` blocks.
Do not reference `bindings::*` directly from driver code; any subsystem-specific raw FFI must first graduate into an explicit abstraction plan.
Treat every auto-discovered callback outside the approved surface as manual-review work until a dedicated family profile exists.
